title: Listing Highlight: 40' Beneteau Gran Turismo 2019
description: Discover the 2019 Beneteau 360955, a sophisticated charter yacht combining French design with practical cruising capabilities for 60+ travelers.
html:
A Modern Motoryacht Built For Comfort And Elegance In Warm Waters

The 2019 Beneteau represents a refined approach to modern yacht design, blending European craftsmanship with the practical amenities that discerning charter guests expect. Built in the early 2020s, this vessel carries the hallmark quality of Beneteau’s established reputation for seaworthiness and comfort. Positioned as an ideal charter platform, the Beneteau offers the perfect balance between performance and leisure, making it an excellent choice for those seeking a contemporary cruising experience in warm climates.

The exterior profile of the 2019 Beneteau reflects contemporary styling with clean lines and purposeful proportions. The vessel’s design emphasizes functionality without sacrificing aesthetic appeal, featuring a well-appointed flybridge that provides commanding views and comfortable outdoor entertaining space. The hull design ensures stable handling in various sea conditions, while the modern propulsion system delivers efficient cruising performance. The topsides are finished to exacting standards, with stainless steel hardware and protective railings that speak to the attention to detail throughout the build. Below decks, the Beneteau showcases intelligent space planning that maximizes comfort in a compact footprint. The main saloon features generous headroom and abundant natural light through strategically positioned windows, creating an inviting atmosphere for relaxation and dining. The galley is fully equipped with modern appliances, allowing charter guests to prepare meals or simply enjoy beverages in style. The sleeping accommodations include multiple cabins with en-suite facilities, ensuring privacy and convenience for all aboard.

The master stateroom occupies a prime position with a full-beam layout that provides exceptional comfort and storage. Guest cabins are thoughtfully designed with quality furnishings and adequate ventilation, while the heads feature modern fixtures and efficient layouts. Climate control throughout the vessel maintains comfort regardless of external conditions, and the sound insulation ensures peaceful rest even when at anchor in busy harbors. Technical specifications underscore the Beneteau’s capability as a charter platform. The vessel measures approximately 36 feet in length, with a beam that provides stability and interior volume. Twin diesel engines deliver reliable propulsion, while modern navigation and communication systems keep guests connected and the vessel safely positioned. The fuel capacity supports extended cruising ranges, and the water systems are sized for comfortable extended voyages.

Key Specifications:

• Length: Approximately 36 feet

• Year Built: 2019

• Propulsion: Twin diesel engines

• Accommodations: Multiple cabins with en-suite heads

• Cruising Profile: Ideal for 60+ charter guests seeking comfort and modern amenities Main Characteristics:

• Contemporary European design with refined styling

• Well-appointed flybridge for outdoor entertaining

• Intelligent interior layout maximizing comfort and functionality

• Modern navigation and communication systems

• Efficient fuel consumption and extended cruising range

The 2019 Beneteau stands as an excellent choice for charter operators and guests seeking a modern, well-maintained vessel with proven reliability. The combination of thoughtful design, quality construction, and practical cruising systems makes this yacht an outstanding platform for exploring coastal destinations in comfort and style. Whether anchored in a secluded cove or docked at a vibrant marina, the Beneteau delivers the experience that discerning travelers expect.
